name: dates: a day written in words after its month is read too, as the model sometimes writes it and as it is said: "November twenty-second", "December first", "the twenty-second of November", "November twenty two"; words that only look like one are not a date: "you may first need", "in December one of the officers"

texts: December first, which is sixteen days from today
It is due on the twenty-second of November.
by November twenty two at the latest
January the eighth, 2027 is the payment deadline
You may first need to add an officer.
In December one of the officers signs.
Come on November 3rd or on November thirtieth.
